pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Get $(bold)Molten Dragonsteel (Lightning)$() by smelting Dragonsteel (Lightning) Ingots in the Smeltery (made from Ice and Fire's $(bold)Lightning Dragon$() materials)$(li)At the Casting Table, pour $(bold)90 mB$() of Molten Dragonsteel (Lightning) (1 ingot) to make Dragonsteel (Lightning) material$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T3$().

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(l:traits/trait_dragonsteel_lightning)Dragonthunder$(): on hit, summons a thunderbolt that deals damage and disarms the target for 3 seconds$(br2)One of the three dragonsteel variants, offering both damage and strong crowd control.
